Day-by-day itinerary

  1. Day 1Arrival and Colombo temples

    Begin in Colombo with the Panchamuga Anjaneyar and Kelaniya temples.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  2. Day 2Chilaw’s Manavari and Munneswaram temples

    Visit the Manavari and Munneswaram temples in the Chilaw area.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  3. Day 3Anuradhapura and Ritigala

    Explore Anuradhapura and ask about access to Ritigala.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  4. Day 4Sigiriya and Koneswaram

    Visit Sigiriya before continuing to Koneswaram Temple in Trincomalee.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  5. Day 5Trincomalee and the east coast

    Spend time around Fort Frederick and the beaches near Trincomalee.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  6. Day 6Dunuwila and Kandy

    Travel through the central countryside and visit the Temple of the Tooth in Kandy.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  7. Day 7Kandy’s temples and gardens

    Spend the day in Kandy with time for Peradeniya, the lake and a cultural performance.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  8. Day 8Ramboda and Nuwara Eliya

    Follow the hill-country route through Ramboda to the temples near Nuwara Eliya.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  9. Day 9Ella and Divurumpola

    Visit Divurumpola and Ravana Falls. Ask about access and fitness requirements for cave visits.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  10. Day 10Kataragama and the south coast

    Continue south to Kataragama and the sites near Ussangoda and Rumassala.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  11. Day 11Galle, Colombo and departure

    Walk through Galle Fort before continuing via Colombo to the airport.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
